name: Godot Development
summary: Expert knowledge of Godot Engine game development including scene creation, node management, GDScript programming, and project structure. Use when working with Godot projects, creating or modifying scenes, adding nodes, writing game scripts, or solving Godot-specific problems.

name: Godot Optimization
summary: Expert knowledge of Godot performance optimization, profiling, bottleneck identification, and optimization techniques. Use when helping improve game performance or analyzing performance issues.

name: Godot Ui
summary: Expert knowledge of Godot's UI system including Control nodes, themes, styling, responsive layouts, and common UI patterns for menus, HUDs, inventories, and dialogue systems. Use when working with Godot UI/menu creation or styling.
